gre_general.value: The chemistry department says no GRE scores are required for its applications.
gre_general.quote: No GRE scores are required for Chemistry applications.

gre_subject.value: No GRE, including the Chemistry subject test, is required for Tufts chemistry applications.
gre_subject.quote: No GRE scores are required for Chemistry applications.

supervisor.value: You do not need a faculty member's support to apply; you choose a research supervisor in your first semester.
supervisor.quote: Applicants do not need the support of a current faculty member to apply to this program.

also.quote: Doctoral students become well acquainted with the faculty and, based on mutual interests, select a research supervisor during their first semester.

deadline.value: Fall 2027 PhD applications are due December 1, 2026; the official table prints no year.

funding.value: The GSAS page says tuition is fully covered for PhD students and many programmes offer assistantships, but no stipend or funding guarantee is stated for chemistry.

also.quote: Tuition for Graduate School of Arts and Sciences PhD students is fully covered by Tufts tuition scholarships.

entry_route.value: The official programme page does not say whether a bachelor's or a master's is needed.

notes: Separate GSAS doctorates also exist for Chemistry/Biotechnology and Chemical Physics (run with Physics); their pages were not used for field values. Stipend terms are not stated on the programme pages.
